text.19:97: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
text.20:26: And ease my task for me;
text.44:58: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
text.54:17: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
text.54:22: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

text.80:20: Then maketh the way easy for him,
text.87:8: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
text.92:7: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
text.92:10: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
